description: Code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page managing theory questions and course selection in an online exam system. Includes event handlers for page load, navigation, course selection, question addition, and exam setup, with database interactions.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheorySet ASP.NET page, handling course selection, question addition, and exam setup.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; currently commented out code for session-based question number.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new theory question to the database, updates question number, and shows alert.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets up a new exam for the selected course, updates exam number, and navigates to AdminPanel.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course dropdown based on semester selection.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on selected course.
